typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOTCDerivSettRMURERAccountStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		accountDDA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> tblIntellimatchGLMonthly	source(output(
		Account as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
tblIntellimatchGLMonthly,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(accountDDA == Account,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		Account as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Account = accountDDA),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOTCDerivSettRMURERAccountStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOTCDerivSettRMURERAccountStaging
